wife दीक्षा and son San- तान;

the seventh name of महादेव.

(V)--an अवतार् of the lord in the गङ्गाद्वार in the eleventh द्वापर with four sons. वा. २३. १५२.
--a son of Gautama; an अवतार् of the १४थ् द्वापर। वा. २३. १६४.
--a daughter of Meru, wife of Harivarsa. भा.
--surname of सूत. His discourse on crea- tion to sages of नैमिष. भा. III. २०. 7. [page१-210+ ५१]
(I)--A son of आहुक of the Kukura family, father of Kamsa and other eight sons. Father of five daughters who were all married to the younger brothers of

. २९.
Hated by his son Kamsa who desired even to kill him and who eventually threw him into prison.
3: Ib. X. ४४. ३३; 1. ६९; ३६. ३४; Vi. V. १५. १८; १८. 6.
Enthroned by कृष्ण, after performing Kamsa's funeral rites;
4: Ib. X. ४५. १२; Vi. V. २१. 9-१२.
got helpful service from कृष्ण and welcomed him to द्वारका.
5: भा.

. २२; I. ११. १६; Vi. V. २४. 7.
In कृष्ण's opinion Ugrasena was the proper person to wear the jewel Syamantaka; did not press it lest there should be a family feud.
6: Vi. IV. १३. २७-28, १०७.
When जरासन्ध beseiged मथुरा, कृष्ण stationed Ugrasena to defend the northern gate; was pre- sented with spoils of war including jewels and ornaments. His part in defence against जरासन्ध's third attack on मथुरा. A member of the यादव सभा; was consulted by कृष्ण as to failure of rains in द्वारका.
7: भा. X. ५०. २०[3] and ४१; [५० (V) ३२-33]; [५१ (V) २५]; [५२ (V) १५]; ५७. ३०[1].
वायु fetched from Indra the hall सुधर्मा for Ugrasena's use;
8: Vi. V. २१. १३-17, ३२.
attacked पौण्ड्रक and laughed at his message. Heard of साम्ब's imprisonment and urged war on the Kurus, order being communicated through बलराम. According to the Kurus, a king only by sufferance.
9: भा. X. ६६ [3]; ६८. १३, २१ and ३४; Vi. V. ३५. १०. १४, २३.
Ordered the मुसल born to साम्ब to be powdered and thrown into the sea.
१०: Vi. V. ३७. ११-12.
Sent to द्वारका for defence after the राजसूय।
११: भा. X. ७६. 7[5].
Welcomed बलराम on his return after a pilgrimage tour.
१२: Ib. X. ७९. २९.
Went to स्यमन्तपञ्चक for solar eclipse.
१३: Ib. X. ८२. २३.
Honoured Nanda.
१४: Ib. X. ८४. ५९ and ६८.
Heard of वृष्णिस् killing one another and of the decease of राम and कृष्ण and bemoaned their loss.
१५: Ib. XI. ३१. १५; Vi. V. ३७. ५७.
Entered fire.
१६: Vi. V. ३८. 4.

--a wife of अक्रूर, and mother of देववान् and Upadeva. M. ४५. ३१.
--a daughter of Ugrasena and wife of अक्रूर (s.v.). वा. ९६. ११२.
(I)--the son of नीप, and father of क्षेम. भा. IX. २१. २९.

(II)--the son of कृत (कार्ता the सामग- वा। प्।) of Paurava dynasty. Father of क्षेम; slew father of पृथुक, the पाञ्चाल Ni1la: Conqueror of नीपस्: was engaged in severe austerities for १८,000 years. Was served by Janamejaya, son of भल्लाट. They were both attacked by नीपस् who were unmoved by उग्रायुध's appeals for peace and protection; then उग्रा- yudha asked Lord of Death to destroy them. Soon he took pity and asked Yama to save them; and this led to a scuffle between Yama and the king who got salvation. M. ४९. ५९-78; वा. ९९. १८२, १९१; Vi. IV. १९. ५३-55. [page१-212+ २५]
